patch.summary: ManageEngine ServiceDesk Plus cost guide: researched plan structure, free/trial flags, who each tier suits, cost scenarios, and value tradeoffs — no invented prices.

blocks.body: ManageEngine ServiceDesk Plus pricing is plan-gated across 4 researched tiers. Free entry: Standard (free up to 5 techs). 30-day trial documented. Compare seat/capacity gates and unlocks — not list-price folklore.

blocks.heading: ManageEngine ServiceDesk Plus cost scenarios to pressure-test
blocks.body: Price ManageEngine ServiceDesk Plus against how you actually buy seats and unlocks — not against a competitor's homepage headline.

scenarios.title: Lean team / free-or-trial first
scenarios.body: Stay on Standard (free up to 5 techs) until a gated capability (premium unlock) becomes mandatory.

scenarios.title: Growing team with gated workflows
scenarios.body: Map must-have workflows (incident management, change and problem management, service catalog) to plan unlocks before expanding seats.

scenarios.title: Hidden / extra cost watch
scenarios.body: Budget risk: Does not outrank ServiceNow (8.7) or Freshservice (8.4). Also check add-ons, overages, and admin time outside the sticker plan.

blocks.title: ManageEngine ServiceDesk Plus cost mistakes to avoid

items.title: Cost trap 1
items.body: Does not outrank ServiceNow (8.7) or Freshservice (8.4)

items.title: Cost trap 2
items.body: Enterprise list price is a large step vs the list price Standard floor — module depth gates by edition

items.title: Cost trap 3
items.body: Zoho/ManageEngine family sprawl (Endpoint, AD, etc.) is adjacent, not this SKU

items.title: Cost trap 4
items.body: ITSM AI is assistance, not Now Assist / Freddy as a buying reason

items.title: Cost trap 5
items.body: Not observability, git, hosting panel, or managed hosting
